name: sovereign-command
description: Persistent real-time grand strategy on a generated planet, played in the browser.

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r tools/worldgen/requirements.txt && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.world: npm run world:samples && npm run world:generate && npm run world:tiles && npm run world:provinces
scripts.check: cd client && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../server && npx tsc --noEmit
